::: {.book-summary} ## Book Summary Insight Matthew presents Jesus as the promised Messiah and King who fulfills the Old Testament. The book teaches that God's kingdom has come through Christ and calls people to faithful discipleship. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 1
Matthew 1:23
Behold, a virgin shall be with child
### Why This Verse Fulfillment of Isaiah 7:14 ### Chapter Insight This chapter establishes Jesus' genealogy and miraculous birth. The key verse emphasizes Jesus as the promised Messiah and Savior. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 2
Matthew 2:11
They presented unto Him gifts
### Why This Verse Visit of the Magi ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the visit of the wise men and God's protection of the child Jesus. The key verse highlights God's sovereign fulfillment of prophecy. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 3
Matthew 3:2
Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand
### Why This Verse John the Baptist's message ### Chapter Insight This chapter introduces John the Baptist and Jesus' baptism. The key verse calls people to repentance in preparation for God's kingdom. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 4
Matthew 4:4
Man shall not live by bread alone
### Why This Verse Jesus' response to temptation ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Jesus' temptation and the beginning of His ministry. The key verse demonstrates victory through obedience to God's Word. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 5
Matthew 5:16
Let your light so shine before men
### Why This Verse Sermon on the Mount highlight ### Chapter Insight This chapter begins the Sermon on the Mount. The key verse describes the character and values of God's kingdom citizens. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 6
Matthew 6:33
Seek ye first the kingdom of God
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted verses in Matthew ### Chapter Insight This chapter teaches about prayer, giving, fasting, and trust. The key verse calls believers to seek first God's kingdom above earthly concerns. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 7
Matthew 7:1
Judge not, that ye be not judged
### Why This Verse One of the best-known verses in Scripture ### Chapter Insight This chapter concludes the Sermon on the Mount. The key verse emphasizes putting Jesus' teachings into practice. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 8
Matthew 8:8
Speak the word only
### Why This Verse Centurion's faith ### Chapter Insight This chapter demonstrates Jesus' authority through miracles. The key verse highlights Christ's power over sickness, nature, and spiritual forces. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 9
Matthew 9:37
The harvest truly is plenteous
### Why This Verse Call for laborers ### Chapter Insight This chapter records additional miracles and Jesus' call to discipleship. The key verse reveals Jesus' mission to call sinners and show mercy. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 10
Matthew 10:16
Wise as serpents and harmless as doves
### Why This Verse Discipleship instruction ### Chapter Insight This chapter commissions the twelve apostles for ministry. The key verse emphasizes faithful witness despite opposition and persecution. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 11
Matthew 11:28
Come unto Me, all ye that labor
### Why This Verse One of Jesus' greatest invitations ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Jesus' response to John the Baptist and His invitation to find rest in Him. The key verse emphasizes the spiritual rest available through Christ. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 12
Matthew 12:34
Out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks
### Why This Verse Heart and speech ### Chapter Insight This chapter highlights growing opposition to Jesus and His authority over the Sabbath. The key verse reveals that mercy and righteousness are central to God's purposes. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 13
Matthew 13:44
The kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field
### Why This Verse Kingdom parable ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains the Parables of the Kingdom. The key verse explains that God's kingdom grows through the reception of His Word. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 14
Matthew 14:29
Peter walked on the water
### Why This Verse Famous faith narrative ### Chapter Insight This chapter records John the Baptist's death, the feeding of the five thousand, and Jesus walking on water. The key verse demonstrates Christ's compassion and divine power. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 15
Matthew 15:8
This people draweth nigh unto Me with their mouth
### Why This Verse Quotation from Isaiah on true worship ### Chapter Insight This chapter contrasts human traditions with true obedience. The key verse teaches that the heart, not outward ritual, determines spiritual condition. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 16
Matthew 16:18
Upon this rock I will build My church
### Why This Verse Foundational church passage ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Peter's confession and Jesus' first prediction of His death. The key verse identifies Jesus as the Messiah, the Son of the living God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 17
Matthew 17:20
If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed
### Why This Verse Famous teaching on faith ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts the Transfiguration. The key verse reveals Jesus' divine glory and authority. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 18
Matthew 18:20
Where two or three are gathered in My name
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted verses in Matthew ### Chapter Insight This chapter teaches humility, forgiveness, and relationships within God's kingdom. The key verse emphasizes childlike humility as essential for discipleship. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 19
Matthew 19:26
With God all things are possible
### Why This Verse Widely quoted encouragement ### Chapter Insight This chapter addresses marriage, wealth, and commitment to Christ. The key verse highlights the cost and reward of following Jesus. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 20
Matthew 20:28
The Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister
### Why This Verse Core statement of Christ's mission ### Chapter Insight This chapter teaches about grace, servanthood, and Jesus' sacrificial mission. The key verse declares that the Son of Man came to serve and give His life as a ransom for many. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 21
Matthew 21:13
My house shall be called the house of prayer
### Why This Verse Jesus cleanses the temple ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Jesus' triumphal entry into Jerusalem and cleansing of the Temple. The key verse presents Jesus as the promised King entering His city in fulfillment of prophecy. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 22
Matthew 22:37
Thou shalt love the Lord thy God
### Why This Verse The Greatest Commandment ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains parables and confrontations with religious leaders. The key verse summarizes the greatest commandments as loving God and loving others. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 23
Matthew 23:12
He that shall humble himself shall be exalted
### Why This Verse Central kingdom principle ### Chapter Insight This chapter pronounces woes upon the scribes and Pharisees. The key verse condemns hypocrisy and calls for genuine righteousness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 24
Matthew 24:35
Heaven and earth shall pass away, but My words shall not pass away
### Why This Verse Enduring authority of Christ ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains the Olivet Discourse concerning future events. The key verse emphasizes readiness and faithfulness while awaiting Christ's return. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 25
Matthew 25:40
As ye have done it unto one of the least of these
### Why This Verse Judgment and compassion ### Chapter Insight This chapter presents parables of preparedness, stewardship, and final judgment. The key verse teaches faithful service in anticipation of the King's return. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 26
Matthew 26:41
Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation
### Why This Verse Gethsemane instruction ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the Last Supper, Gethsemane, and Jesus' arrest. The key verse reveals the establishment of the New Covenant through Christ's sacrifice. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 27
Matthew 27:46
My God, My God, why hast Thou forsaken Me?
### Why This Verse Christ's cry from the cross ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Jesus' trial, crucifixion, death, and burial. The key verse highlights Christ's sacrificial death for the sins of humanity. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 28
Matthew 28:19
Go ye therefore, and teach all nations
### Why This Verse The Great Commission ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the resurrection and the Great Commission. The key verse commissions believers to make disciples of all nations under Christ's authority. :::
